description: Reading the stop-request desk (S55 T5, LC15): filtered by loop and/or status (both optional — an empty filter reads the whole desk), open first and oldest first (the store's order, so the client never re-sorts the audit). The rows are INERT records of agents that asked a person to stop a loop: who asked, from which step, why, and how the person settled it (or that it is still open). Nothing here moves a loop.
